title: Offline Khulna Soil Salinity & Hydrological GIS
region: Khulna District, Southwestern Coastal Delta, Bangladesh

spatial_reference.projected_crs: EPSG:32645 (WGS 84 / UTM Zone 45N for metric analysis)
spatial_reference.vertical_datum: PWD Datum (Public Works Department, Bangladesh, +0.46m above MSL)

classification_standard: UNESCO / FAO / SRDI Bangladesh Standard Soil Salinity Classification

boundary.geojson.title: Khulna District Study Area Boundary
boundary.geojson.source: Survey of Bangladesh (SoB) & CEGIS National Cadastre

salinity_period1.geojson.title: Soil Salinity Period 1: Post-Monsoon Flushing (November)
salinity_period1.geojson.source: SRDI Soil Salinity Survey & BWDB Estuarine Telemetry
salinity_period1.geojson.validation: 10 Upazila administrative polygons with verified EC attributes

salinity_period2.geojson.title: Soil Salinity Period 2: Mid-Dry Season / Boro Stage (February)
salinity_period2.geojson.source: SRDI Soil Salinity Survey & BWDB Estuarine Telemetry
salinity_period2.geojson.validation: 10 Upazila administrative polygons with verified EC attributes

salinity_period3.geojson.title: Soil Salinity Period 3: Peak Dry Season / Marine Surge (April)
salinity_period3.geojson.source: SRDI Soil Salinity Survey & BWDB Estuarine Telemetry
salinity_period3.geojson.validation: 10 Upazila administrative polygons with verified EC attributes

rivers.geojson.title: Khulna Estuarine River Network
rivers.geojson.source: NASA SWOT SWORD Database (v16) & BWDB River Network Survey
rivers.geojson.validation: 6 connected curvilinear river centerlines (Passur, Shibsa, Rupsha, Kobodak, Bhairab, Kazibacha)

observation_stations.geojson.title: Ground Truth Hydrometric Stations & Telemetry Reaches
observation_stations.geojson.source: BWDB Hydrology, Khulna WASA & NASA SWOT KaRIn Telemetry
observation_stations.geojson.unit: dS/m (EC) and m PWD (Water Surface Elevation)
observation_stations.geojson.validation: Point geometries with empirical min, mean, max EC and observation counts
